scripts.test: vitest run examples/utils.test.ts && yarn workspaces run test
scripts.size: sh -c 'cd packages/$0 && npm pack --dry-run 2>&1 | grep "npm notice package size"'
scripts.size:install: sh -c 'PKG=$0; DIR=tmp/size-$PKG; rm -rf $DIR && mkdir -p $DIR && npm pack ./packages/$PKG --pack-destination $DIR -q && cd $DIR && npm init -y -q > /dev/null && npm install *.tgz --omit=dev -q && echo "" && echo "Install size for $PKG:" && du -sh node_modules && echo "" && echo "Dep breakdown:" && du -sh node_modules/* | sort -rh; cd - > /dev/null && rm -rf $DIR'
scripts.size:install:otel: sh -c 'PKG=$0; DIR=tmp/size-$PKG-otel; OTEL="@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node@^2.8.0 @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base@^2.8.0 @opentelemetry/exporter-trace-otlp-http@^0.219.0 @opentelemetry/otlp-exporter-base@^0.219.0 @opentelemetry/resources@^2.8.0 @opentelemetry/context-async-hooks@^2.8.0 @opentelemetry/core@^2.8.0"; rm -rf $DIR && mkdir -p $DIR && npm pack ./packages/$PKG --pack-destination $DIR -q && cd $DIR && npm init -y -q > /dev/null && npm install *.tgz $OTEL --omit=dev -q && echo "" && echo "Install size for $PKG (with OTel):" && du -sh node_modules && echo "" && echo "Dep breakdown:" && du -sh node_modules/* | sort -rh; cd - > /dev/null && rm -rf $DIR'
